semantics: Each case is independent. Tokens and request IDs are synthetic fixtures, not real credentials.
valid is shape/raw-bound/correlation acceptance only; it does not assert native authority, entropy, candidate eligibility, execution or activation.
Decode the raw JSON strings only inside the real adapter under test. Do not parse/re-encode first: duplicates, escapes and whitespace are deliberate.
marker_json is the plex_servers capability value; null means the marker is absent. String null means an explicitly null marker.

typed_correlation valid means valid original runtime/op are available; it does not mandate typed error emission before outer controller validation. unavailable requires outer rejection without invented typed fields.
request_json is the whole POST /api/requests body; response_json is the whole POST /api/responses body, including id/status/data. Auth/device query binding is supplied by the harness.
Replies are checked against request_params and the synthetic pending request ID, with fresh owner/device/operator bindings in the integration harness.
The original 16-KiB HTTP request bound is a controller ingress check. Native receives transformed id/expires_at/action/params poll items; reserializing them cannot prove the original HTTP bound.
Native duplicate checks belong before raw poll projection; CLI/controller whole-reply limits must use retained response bytes, not compact reserialization of data.
Grammar-minimum contexts test syntax only. Production context issuance must independently meet the frozen 128-bit entropy or equivalent binding requirement.
Error-code vectors test the closed wire vocabulary, not whether every code is reachable for every operation.
